subjects.name: Current Affairs
subjects.scope_note: Covers major government issues, events, and sports at state, national, and international levels. Focus on recent happenings and developments.

subjects.name: World Geography
subjects.scope_note: Includes significant physical features of the world such as important places, mountains, and oceans.

subjects.name: Indian Ecology and Wildlife
subjects.name_hindi: भारत की पारिस्थितिक और वन्य जीवन
subjects.scope_note: Focuses on the ecological systems and wildlife of India, including biodiversity and conservation efforts.

subjects.name: Rajasthan Geography
subjects.scope_note: Covers the natural geography of Rajasthan, including climate, vegetation, soil, population, unemployment, poverty, drought, famine, and desertification issues.

subjects.name: Rajasthan Natural Resources
subjects.scope_note: Includes mines and minerals, forests, land and water, animal resources, wildlife, and conservation in Rajasthan.

subjects.name: Agriculture and Economic Development (India & Rajasthan)
subjects.name_hindi: कृषि और आर्थिक विकास (भारत और राजस्थान)
subjects.scope_note: Covers food and commercial crops, agro-based industries, major irrigation and river valley projects, and projects for the development of desert and barren lands in Rajasthan, along with tribal economy.

subjects.name: Indian History and Culture
subjects.scope_note: Focuses on major monuments and literary works of India, including tribal economy, dialects and literature, music, dance and drama, religious beliefs, saints, poets, folk deities, handicrafts, fairs, festivals, customs, attire, and ornaments.

subjects.name: Rajasthan History and Culture
subjects.scope_note: Focuses on major monuments and literary works of Rajasthan, including tribal economy, dialects and literature, music, dance and drama, religious beliefs, saints, poets, folk deities, handicrafts, fairs, festivals, customs, attire, and ornaments, with specific reference to their folk and tribal aspects.

subjects.name: Mental Ability
subjects.section: तर्कशक्ति, गणित और भाषा [Reasoning, Math and Language]
subjects.scope_note: Tests general mental aptitude and problem-solving skills.

subjects.name: Reasoning and Analytical Ability
subjects.section: तर्कशक्ति, गणित और भाषा [Reasoning, Math and Language]
subjects.scope_note: Evaluates logical reasoning and analytical skills through various types of questions.

subjects.name: English Language
subjects.section: तर्कशक्ति, गणित और भाषा [Reasoning, Math and Language]
subjects.scope_note: Covers grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, and other aspects of the English language.

subjects.name: Hindi Language
subjects.section: तर्कशक्ति, गणित और भाषा [Reasoning, Math and Language]
subjects.scope_note: Covers grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, and other aspects of the Hindi language.

subjects.name: Mathematics
subjects.section: तर्कशक्ति, गणित और भाषा [Reasoning, Math and Language]
subjects.scope_note: Includes arithmetic, algebra, geometry, and other mathematical concepts relevant to competitive exams.

subjects.name: Administrative Structure of Rajasthan
subjects.section: प्रशासनिक ढाँचा और कंप्यूटर [Administrative Structure and Computer]
subjects.scope_note: Covers the administrative structure at state, district, tehsil, and panchayat levels in Rajasthan.

subjects.name: Basic Computer Knowledge
subjects.section: प्रशासनिक ढाँचा और कंप्यूटर [Administrative Structure and Computer]
subjects.scope_note: Includes fundamental concepts of computers, hardware, software, operating systems, and basic applications.
